name: mdh-coop-line-deposit-withdrawal
description: ระบบยื่นคำขอฝากถอนเงินผ่าน LINE ของสหกรณ์ออมทรัพย์สาธารณสุขจังหวัดมุกดาหาร จำกัด

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p backend && tsc -p backend/test && tsc -p apps
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:member && npm run build:staff
scripts.push:test: npm run build:backend && clasp -P backend/.clasp.test.json push -f
scripts.push:prod: npm run build:backend && clasp -P backend/.clasp.prod.json push -f
scripts.pages:test: npm run build:member:test && npm run build:staff:test && npx wrangler pages deploy apps/member/dist --project-name mdh-coop-member-test && npx wrangler pages deploy apps/staff/dist --project-name mdh-coop-staff-test
scripts.pages:prod: npm run build:member && npm run build:staff && npx wrangler pages deploy apps/member/dist --project-name mdh-coop-member && npx wrangler pages deploy apps/staff/dist --project-name mdh-coop-staff
